#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# collect_env.sh
# Appends basic local environment details to a hidden file in the build
# artifacts directory for later review.
# This script does not transmit data anywhere.

ARTIFACTS_DIR="${BUILD_ARTIFACTS_DIR:-${ARTIFACTS_DIR:-build}}"
OUTPUT_FILE="${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/.env_info"

mkdir -p "$ARTIFACTS_DIR"

{
  echo "=== Environment Snapshot ==="
  echo "Timestamp UTC: $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
  echo

  echo "=== System Architecture ==="
  echo "OS: $(uname -s)"
  echo "Kernel: $(uname -r)"
  echo "Architecture: $(uname -m)"

  if command -v lscpu >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    cpu_model="$(lscpu | awk -F: '/Model name/ {gsub(/^[ \t]+/, "", $2); print $2; exit}')"
    cpu_cores="$(lscpu | awk -F: '/^CPU\(s\)/ {gsub(/^[ \t]+/, "", $2); print $2; exit}')"
    [ -n "$cpu_model" ] && echo "CPU: $cpu_model"
    [ -n "$cpu_cores" ] && echo "CPU cores: $cpu_cores"
  fi

  echo
  echo "=== User Information ==="
  echo "User: ${USER:-$(id -un 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)}"
  echo "UID: $(id -u 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
  echo "GID: $(id -g 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
  echo "Home: ${HOME:-unknown}"
  echo "Shell: ${SHELL:-unknown}"

  echo
  echo "=== Runtime Context ==="
  echo "Working directory: $(pwd)"
  echo "Hostname: $(hostname 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
  echo
} >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"

echo "Environment details appended to $OUTPUT_FILE"
